coach.title: {{name}}, your coach
coach.setupArchive: Your analysed games already contain useful lessons. Choose a session and we will revisit them calmly.
coach.setupLichess: No personal positions yet, but the chess puzzles are ready whenever you are.
coach.archiveTurn: {{colour}} to move. This position appeared just after a costly move. Find the punishment.
coach.lichessTurn: {{colour}} to move. Look for forcing moves before calculating quieter ideas.
coach.wrong: Not this one. The move is legal, but it lets the key opportunity slip. Recheck checks, captures and threats.
coach.correctContinue: Good move. Watch the reply; the idea is not finished yet.
coach.yourTurnAgain: That was the expected defence. Continue the combination.
coach.hint: A useful clue: examine {{move}}. Work out why it is stronger before playing it.
coach.solvedClean: Excellent. You found the whole idea without help.
coach.solvedAfterHelp: Solved. Repeat the pattern mentally once more so the idea sticks.
coach.solutionShown: Here is the complete line. Use the controls in the objective card to review every position.
coach.noArchive: I cannot build a puzzle until at least one analysed game is in your Archive.
coach.noFiltered: There are no unseen puzzles with these filters. Try another theme or difficulty.
coach.loadError: I could not load the training positions. Refresh the page and we will try again.
coach.positionError: This line contains a position I cannot reproduce safely, so I have stopped it.
coach.changeFilters: Adjust the session whenever you like; your completed positions remain saved.

states.loadingBody: Reading your Archive and loading the chess puzzles.
states.errorTitle: The training could not be loaded
states.errorBody: Nothing has been lost. Refresh the page to try again.
states.noArchiveBody: Analyse and save a game to create positions from both players' mistakes.
states.noMatchBody: Change the theme or difficulty to keep training without repeating positions.

puzzle.archiveContext: Move {{move}} after {{badMove}} in {{game}}. Punish the error and keep the advantage.
puzzle.lichessContext: Every solver move in the line is an only move or a clearly strongest continuation.
